capabilities: Sync the vault with a GitHub repository via a single ribbon action
Pull remote changes and push local changes
Open unmerged files for conflict resolution
Configure the remote URL (HTTPS or SSH) in settings
Adjust notice levels to reduce sync UI noise
extras: Does not support branching; everything is pushed to main. Mobile support is not yet available. Personal access tokens can be embedded in the remote URL, which the README itself flags as not recommended. Plugin is described as small (~200 SLOC) and primarily for personal use.
motivation: The author keeps a private GitHub repository for Markdown notes and wanted to pull and push notes from within Obsidian without running scripts or a command line.
problem: Syncing a vault across devices via GitHub normally requires opening a terminal to run pull/push commands or setting up a timed script outside Obsidian.
summary: Git-based sync plugin that pushes and pulls a vault to a personal GitHub repository from within Obsidian.
